title_en: The old car comes back to life
grammar_focus: 被动语态综合复习(方案B换情节·原 L69 KS10/21/34/45 考点原样承载):一般过去被动 was/were made、情态被动 can/could/must be done、现在完成被动 has been done、过去完成被动 had been kept、过去进行被动 was being cleaned、完成式非谓语被动 having been stored
scene: 上个月,一辆稀有的老爷车被送到了我们博物馆——博物馆最近才收购了它。它1925年在德国制造,一共只造过十辆。多年来它一直被存放在一个旧车库里,几乎被人遗忘。送来时,引擎几乎发动不了。“它能修好,”我们的首席技师说,并指示他的团队检查每一个零件。在清理这辆车时,座位下面发现了制造商的名字。由于被存放了这么久,这辆车需要大量的修理。每个零件都被仔细检查,坏的都被更换。随着信心不断增强,团队一直干下去,几个月后这辆车已被完全修复到它最初的状态。如今它受到每一位参观博物馆的人的赞赏。

grammar_card.title: 被动语态综合复习
grammar_card.intro: 各种时态的被动都是 be + 过去分词,时态变在 be 上:一般过去 was made、情态 can/could/must be done、过去进行 was being cleaned、过去完成 had been kept、现在完成 has been restored。介词或连词后用动名词被动,完成式为 having been done(Having been stored for years…)。对过去的推测(被动)用 must have been + 过去分词。

rows: can be repaired / must have been kept
had been kept / had been stored

specialRules.rule: 完成式的非谓语被动用 having been + 过去分词,作状语说明原因或先发生:Having been stored for so long, the car needed a lot of work。
对过去情况的推测(被动)用 must have been + 过去分词:It must have been kept in a dry garage(它一定是被放在干燥的车库里)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened to the old car at the museum?
options: It was fully restored to its original condition after months of work
It was sold to a private collector
It was left in the garage

passage: Last month, a rare old car was brought to our museum, which had recently acquired it. It was made in Germany in 1925, and only ten of them were ever built. For years it had been kept in an old garage and almost forgotten. When it arrived, the engine could hardly be started. 'It can be repaired,' our chief mechanic said, and he instructed his team to check every part. While the car was being cleaned, the maker's name was found under the seat. Having been stored for so long, the car needed a great deal of work. Every part was carefully checked, and the broken ones were replaced. With growing confidence, the team worked on, and after months the car has been fully restored to its original condition. Now it is admired by everyone who visits the museum.

stage5.stem: "This car ___ in Germany in 1925."(一般过去被动)
"Only ten of them ___ ever built."(一般过去被动,主语复数)
stage5.stem_cn: 这种车一共只造过十辆。

stage5.stem: "The maker's name ___ under the seat."(一般过去被动:被发现)
stage5.stem_cn: 制造商的名字在座位下被发现了。

stage5.stem: "When it arrived, the engine could hardly ___."(情态被动:几乎发动不了)
stage5.stem_cn: 送来时,引擎几乎发动不了。

stage5.stem: "'It ___,' said the mechanic."(情态被动:它能被修好)
"It ___ in a dry garage — it looks so clean."(对过去的推测·被动:一定是被放在…)
stage5.stem_cn: 它一定是被放在干燥的车库里——看起来这么干净。

stage5.stem: "After months of work, the car ___ fully restored."(现在完成被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 几个月的修理后,这辆车已被完全修复。

stage5.stem: "The museum ___ several rare cars this year."(现在完成主动对照:已收购)
stage5.stem_cn: 博物馆今年已收购了几辆稀有的车。

stage5.stem: "All the broken parts ___ replaced."(现在完成被动,主语复数)
stage5.stem_cn: 所有坏零件都已被更换。

stage5.stem: "For years it ___ in an old garage."(过去完成被动:一直被存放)
stage5.stem_cn: 多年来它一直被存放在一个旧车库里。

stage5.stem: "The car ___ for so long that it needed a lot of work."(过去完成被动:被存放)
stage5.stem_cn: 这辆车被存放了这么久,需要大量修理。

stage5.stem: "While the car ___ cleaned, the name was found."(过去进行被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 在清理这辆车时,发现了名字。

stage5.stem: "When I visited, the engine ___ repaired by two mechanics."(过去进行被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 我参观时,引擎正被两名技师修理。

stage5.stem: "Every part ___ checked when the manager arrived."(过去进行被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 经理到时,每个零件正被检查。

stage5.stem: "___ stored for so long, the car needed a great deal of work."(完成式非谓语被动,作状语)
stage5.stem_cn: 由于被存放了这么久,这辆车需要大量修理。

stage5.stem: "___ kept in a dry place, the engine was still in good condition."(完成式非谓语被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 由于被放在干燥处,引擎仍然状况良好。

stage5.stem: "We expected the maker's name ___ somewhere on the car."(不定式被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们估计制造商的名字会印在车上某处。

stage5.stem: "The owner wanted the car ___ to its original condition."(不定式被动:想让车被修复)
stage5.stem_cn: 车主想让这辆车被修复到原来的状态。
